Steel sits between iron and diamond. Steel tools last 500 uses and dig at 7.0 speed, a little faster than iron, but they mine what iron mines: obsidian and Arcite still need diamond.
- Tools use vanilla recipes with Steel Ingots and sticks. Repair them, and the armor, with Steel Ingots.
- Steel armor: 2 / 7 / 5 / 2 armor, 1.0 toughness, like iron plus a little toughness.

# Steel Hammer and Excavator
The Hammer (a pickaxe) and Excavator (a shovel) break a 3×3 area facing the side you hit, 1 durability per block, 1,500 uses.
- The extra blocks only break if the tool is good against them and they are no harder than the block you hit, so a hammer on stone won't eat the ores around it.
- They skip chests and other block entities, and unbreakable blocks.
- Sneak to break one block. The outline shows what will break.
- They dig at 70% of a normal steel pickaxe or shovel.
